title: Knopia
description: A non-profit smp, est. Jan 2023, supports offline & Bedrock.
body:
# **Basic Information**
Launched on 2023/1/19, formerly known as Supercharge / Maintrav / MaintravWorld. A non-profit vanilla survival server funded and maintained solely by the owner. The server uses only lightweight plugins that slightly enhance vanilla gameplay — no land claiming or economy plugins. It relies on operation logging and chunk rollbacks to prevent griefing.
## **Server Software Information**
Uses the Luminol, which runs multi-threaded while preserving vanilla mechanics as much as possible, and supports the vast majority of redstone machines.
## **Server Hardware Information**
Self-built physical machine, China Telecom home broadband, Intel 11900F processor, 32GB RAM, 1TB storage, 7x24H stable operation.
## Server Plugin Information
### **Geyser**
Bedrock interoperability, supports multi-platform play.
### **EasyBot**
Bridges server with chat groups; requires linking a social account to play.
### **CoreProtect**
Logging and inspection; all actions are traceable, area rollback available.
### **Authme**
protects offline-mode accounts from theft; Bedrock players skip login.
### **Simple Voice Chat**
easier communication via voice chat.
### **Other Small Features Include:**
1.Use a command to consume ancient debris and teleport to spawn or world spawn point.
2.When a tree's trunk is chopped down, its leaves decay quickly. Using a tool with Silk Touch to chop the trunk drops the leaves.
3.Right-click while holding a shulker box, crafting table, etc., to open them directly.
4.Restrict certain item operations for new players who haven't played enough total time.
5.Using a goat horn calls all pets within a 64‑block radius to your side, and they follow you for a short while.
6.While leading a tamed pet, sneak+right-click on another player to transfer the pet to them.
7.Loyalty‑enchanted tridents will return even if thrown into the void.
8.Most mobs have a chance to drop their own head upon death.
9.When a player is killed by another player, the victim drops their head.
10.Fire charges can be thrown with an empty hand.
11.Sneak+click on an armor stand to change its pose.
12.Breaking a painting with a Silk Touch tool yields that specific painting variant.
13.Spawners can be mined and dropped with Silk Touch (decorational only).
14.Right‑click an item frame with shears to make it invisible.
15.During thunderstorms, lightning strikes have a chance to spawn a zombie riding a zombie horse.
16.Villagers are attracted to players holding an emerald block.
17.Right‑click a named mob with shears to remove the name tag.
18.Restores the 1.8 sword blocking mechanic, slightly adjusted to fit the new version.
19.Removes the “Too Expensive!” limit on anvils, and provides a clever way for players to put conflicting enchantments together.
20.When enough players sleep, a short animation plays and the night is skipped.
21.Explosions from creepers, ghast fireballs, withers, etc., do not destroy blocks.
### **Server Operation Policy**
Non‑profit, forever; world save, long‑lasting.
Follow original game principles, strive for goodness and beauty.
Rules are established; mistakes will be addressed.
Act according to regulations; rights and responsibilities are clear.
### **Current Server Status**
The server spawn has been changed, new players can start with a fresh experience.
Updated some plugins, still improving server functionality.
Developing useful and interesting small features.
### **Future Server Plans**
Planned upgrade to a 9950X platform (and related components) from late April to mid‑June.
Develop a series of unique items, enchantments, and features that don’t interfere with vanilla gameplay.
Build a creative server (identical to the main survival server) for players to test their machines.
# **服务器基本信息**
2023/1/19开服，曾用名Supercharge Maintrav MaintravWorld，为公益性的原版生存服务器，由服主独自出资与维护，服务器插件仅轻量改良原版玩法，无圈地经济等插件，以操作查询和区块回档防止恶意破坏
## **服务端信息**
使用luminol服务端，多线程运行的同时尽可能还原了原版特性，且支持绝大部分生电机器
## **服务器主机信息**
自建物理机，中国电信家用宽带，11900f处理器，32G内存，1T储存，7x24H稳定运行
## **服务器插件信息**
### **Geyser**
基岩互通，支持多平台游玩
### **EasyBot**
群服互通，游玩需绑定社交账号
### **CoreProtect**
操作留痕有迹可循，可局部回档
### **Authme**
登录，离线服务器防止盗号
## **其他小特性包括：**
1.通过命令消耗远古残骸传送到出生点与世界生成点
2.砍掉树干的树，其树叶会快速腐烂，使用精准采集工具砍掉树干则掉落树叶
3.手持右键直接打开潜影盒工作台等道具
4.限制不满游戏时长的新玩家操作某些物品
5.手持山羊角使用，即可把周围64格内的宠物唤到身边并跟随一小段时间
6.牵着已驯服的宠物，潜行+右键另一位玩家，即可把宠物转交给对方
7.附魔忠诚的三叉戟掉入虚空也能返回
8.大部分生物死亡时有概率掉落自己的头
9.玩家被其他玩家击杀时会掉落头颅
10.空手可投掷烈焰弹
11.潜行+点击盔甲架能切换盔甲架的姿势
12.用带有精准采集的工具破坏画，就能获得该画作的变种
13.刷怪笼可通过精准采集挖掘掉落（仅装饰）
14.剪刀右键物品展示框让其隐形
15.雷暴天闪电劈下有几率生成骑着僵尸马的僵尸
16.村民会被手持绿宝石块的玩家吸引
17.用剪刀右键已命名的生物能取下命名牌
18.恢复1.8的剑格挡机制，并稍微修改以适应新版本
19.去除铁砧的过于昂贵机制，并提供一种巧妙的方法支持玩家附魔冲突附魔
20.当玩家睡眠比例达标时，播放一小段动画跳过夜晚
21.苦力怕、恶魂火球、凋零等生物爆炸不破坏方块
## **服务器运营方针**
公益恒守，存档长延；原旨恪遵，向善向美
规章既立，过误必绳；依律而行，责权朗然
## **服务器当前动态**
更换了服务器出生点，新玩家可当开荒游玩
更新部分插件，完善服务器功能中
开发实用、有趣的小特性
## **服务器未来动向**
计划四月末至六月中旬升级9950x及相关平台
开发一系列不影响原版游玩的特色道具、附魔、特性等
搭建与主服相同的创造服供玩家测试机器
